events.description: As of late October, IG had completed planning for a US operation on behalf of Bin Ladin, but it was on hold.
IG reportedly obtained SA-7 missiles to move from Yemen into Saudi Arabia to shoot down an Egyptian or US plane.
CIA memorandum reporting preparations for US attacks including hijacking.
Reported deadline: Bin Ladin might hijack US aircraft before the start of Ramadan.
CIA memorandum reports Bin Ladin and allies preparing attacks in the US including a hijacking to free Abd al-Rahman, Yousef and 'Awda.
IG completed planning for a US operation on behalf of Bin Ladin, but it was put on hold.
IG leader reportedly planning to hijack a US airliner within 'next couple of weeks' to free Abd al-Rahman and other prisoners.
Source said Bin Ladin might hijack US aircraft before Ramadan on 20 December; two operational team members evaded security checks in a trial run at an unidentified New York airport.
IG obtained SA-7 missiles in Yemen, intending to move them to Saudi Arabia to shoot down an Egyptian plane or US aircraft.
Bin Ladin associate in Sudan told a colleague in Kandahar he had shipped containers to Afghanistan.
Bin Ladin associates discussed picking up a package in Malaysia, using 'ninth month of pregnancy' language.
Alleged Bin Ladin supporter in Yemen told his mother of a 'commerce' abroad and impending 'marriage' surprise, possible codewords for attacks.

key_claims: Bin Ladin and allies were reportedly preparing US attacks, including a hijacking to free 'Abd al-Rahman, Yousef and 'Awda.
IG planning for a US operation on behalf of Bin Ladin was complete but on hold as of late October 1998.
A Bin Ladin operative from Saudi Arabia was to meet US counterparts to discuss options including hijacking.
No group directly tied to al-Qa'ida had previously carried out an aircraft hijacking.
IG reportedly obtained SA-7 missiles in Yemen to attack aircraft.
